metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-au[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]XPrompts sub-tab for the Admin Center Statistics panel[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The SASE Admin Center Statistics tab has an XPrompts sub-tab that [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reports which xprompts agent prompts actually used and how often, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]lets `g` regroup those counts by model, project, and co-usage, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]lets the user zoom into one xprompt for a full breakdown of its [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]models, projects, partner xprompts, and usage over time.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]xprompt_statistics.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-au[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-au/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Project launch-boundary xprompt usage into the artifact scan [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]record and index[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]core-scan[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-scan: in sase-core, add a UsedXPromptWire projection of each [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]artifact directory's xprompts.json to the agent-artifact scan record, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sign that file so stale rows re-index, and bump the artifact index [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]schema so existing indexes rebuild with the new projection.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]XPrompt aggregation section in the run-statistics wire and [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]query[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]core-stats[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-scan[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-stats: in sase-core, fold the projected xprompt usage of every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in-window run into a new optional xprompts section of the run-statistics[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]response, with ranked rows, bounded model/project/partner cross-tabs, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and an optional focused single-xprompt payload driven by new request [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]knobs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Python statistics models and builder for the XPrompts view[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]py-stats[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]py-stats: add the XPrompts view models, payload builder, and query [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]request knobs to sase.stats so the view is built from the agreed payload[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]contract, degrades to an explicit unavailable state when the section is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]missing, and is covered by fixture-driven tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]XPrompts sub-tab with four grouping strategies[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]tui-view[dim] · [dim][/dim]after py-stats[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tui-view: register the XPrompts view in the Statistics pane, render its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]four `g` grouping strategies with legends and honest empty states, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]make the tab strip fit nine tabs at narrow widths.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Zoom into one xprompt with a focus picker, scope chip, and [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]keys[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]tui-focus[dim] · [dim][/dim]after tui-view[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tui-focus: add the xprompt focus picker modal, the XPrompt scope chip, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the focus/clear keymaps and their configuration surfaces, the focused [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]body rendering, and the contextual help updates.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Land the cross-repo contract, snapshots, and documentation[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]land[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-stats, tui-focus[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]land: raise the sase-core-rs floor together with the Python [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]artifact-index schema constant, verify the feature end to end against [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]real recorded data, add the new PNG visual snapshots, and document the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sub-tab and its keys.[/#D7D7AF]
